msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia son-de-lunares-21.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a red fitted flamenca dress with ruffled sleeves and a long ruffled skirt from the reference, walking at a sunny square in the centre of Valencia, Spain, with orange trees and classic buildings, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia son-de-lunares-21.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a red fitted flamenca dress with ruffled sleeves and a long ruffled skirt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia son-de-lunares-18.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a green flamenca dress with white polka dots and ruffles from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia son-de-lunares-28.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a yellow flamenca dress with black polka dots and a black fringed shawl from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia son-de-lunares-30.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a romería outfit: a white blouse with a brown belt and a colourful floral tiered skirt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.

IMAGEN 2 «p6» (formato 3:4, referencia son-de-lunares-32.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of large flamenca drop earrings in red, green and gold (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «l2» (formato 3:4, referencia son-de-lunares-22.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Lifestyle fashion photo: a model wearing an embroidered silk shawl with long sage green fringes on a dress form from the reference, candid and relaxed in a sunny street of Valencia, Spain, natural light, framed from the knees up, editorial, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 5 «b» (formato 16:9, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA C): Wide interior photo: the inside of a flamenca and Spanish dance shop with rails of colourful polka dot flamenca dresses, fringed shawls, flamenco shoes on shelves and a wall of flowers, no people, no text, inspired by the reference, photographed like a design magazine, beautiful natural light, inviting and tidy. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage.
